api_doc_gaps.endpoint: DocumentAccess.fetchDocuments (CON-DOC-004): outcome of a document source row whose type column is NULL
api_doc_gaps.detail: SVC-API · REQ-DOC-006 takes each document's type from the type column, DocumentSourceRow allows a NULL column value and says the fetch procedure decides what such a row is, but no step of fetchDocuments and no REQ states the outcome · interim: the row is reported, never dropped (G6) — its outcome is read or unreadable as its content allows, with documentType null; it satisfies no required type, so the MISSING outcomes are unaffected

A request with an Accept header the endpoint cannot produce (e.g. text/plain) answers DOC-500 because the error catalog has no 406/400 code for it; INT maps the same case to INT-400-REQUEST-INVALID. The factory is asked for a code (406 or 400) to add to the DOC error-catalog and API document.

api_doc_gaps.endpoint: document source query: platform MCP query channel bean, credential secret store, and readOnly on CON-REG-011 not stated
api_doc_gaps.resolution: OPEN — MISSING_IN_DOCS pending spec clarification · interim implemented: SpringAiMcpQueryChannel over the Spring AI MCP client; endpoint convention `mcp:<client>`; query-tool args {sql, binds, maxRows} taken from the local Oracle MCP server; factory to confirm the protocol
api_doc_gaps.detail: PORTS-QUERY · (1) the 'query-executor bean of the platform track' (ADR-DOC-001, CHK plan) is defined by no delivered package — DOC declares port McpQueryChannel and answers SOURCE_QUERY_FAILED when no bean is present; (2) no secret store is defined for the credential reference (ADR-REG-009) — interim: the reference names a Spring Environment property holding username:password; (3) CON-REG-011 carries no readOnly, so RULE-DOC-007 cannot be read through the contract — REG's CHK_REG_CONNECTION_READ_ONLY / RULE-REG-015 guarantee every supplied connection is read-only; the guard refuses only an absent connection — UPDATE 2026-10-02: io.agenticai.platform.mcp.SpringAiMcpQueryChannel (@Component) implements the port: REG endpoint `mcp:<client>` names a spring.ai.mcp.client.* connection; one tools/call of queryTool with {sql: stored text unchanged, binds: {<inputName>: requestNumber}, maxRows: maxRows+1}; parses text JSON {rowCount, rows}; isError → exception → NotRead/SOURCE_QUERY_FAILED; deadline enforced on the call; MCP→ToolCallback bridge disabled (spring.ai.mcp.client.toolcallback.enabled=false, start-up refuses any ToolCallbackProvider — G1); credential held by the MCP server's own config, credentialReference not read by the channel. Items (2)/(3) unchanged.

api_doc_gaps.endpoint: aias.documents.reading-model: provider dependency and connection settings (endpoint, credential) not stated
api_doc_gaps.detail: PORTS-MODEL · the plan names provider/model/tier/instruction only and no Spring AI provider starter (domain-profile D3: provider decided before go-live) · interim: v1 supports provider 'openai' only (spring-ai-starter-model-openai 2.0.1, built on the OpenAI Java SDK; an OpenAI-compatible base URL covers local/free-tier gateways), connection settings read from spring.ai.openai.base-url / spring.ai.openai.api-key (absent key = client without credential); the starter's default chat model is disabled with spring.ai.model.chat=none; any other provider or a blank model = no model configured → READING_FAILED (REQ-DOC-033) · UPDATE 2026-10-03: scanned PDFs are sent to the reading model as page images (PDFBox render, ≤ 10 pages, one call per document) because OpenAI-compatible providers such as Gemini reject the `file` content part; factory to confirm — SpringAiDocumentReadingAdapter + adapter-side PdfPageRenderer (port signature unchanged): a PDF reaching the reading step (blank text layer, REQ-DOC-027) is rendered in memory (renderImageWithDPI 150 DPI, grayscale PNG, no temp file, nothing kept) and its pages sent in page order as image Media of the ONE user message beside the configured instruction (2 messages, 0 tools, REQ-DOC-046/048/057); the page cap is the documented constant PdfPageRenderer.MAX_PAGES = 10 (no aias.documents.reading-model.* key — the plan names provider/model/tier/instruction only; factory to decide whether it becomes configuration); rendered bytes bounded by aias.check.max-file-size; more pages or bytes → UNREADABLE / READING_FAILED with the bound in the detail (not TOO_LARGE: REQ-DOC-042 is a document refused unread, this one is within the size); a render failure → READING_FAILED naming the exception; rendering runs inside the call bounded by the Check's remaining time, deadline passed → OUT_OF_TIME; images are sent unchanged
